description: Search registered Design, Memory, Reference, and Skill sources. Provide at least one of `lexicalQuery` or `semanticQuery`. Summary results use one line per document in `<path> :: <summary>` format. Detailed results start each document with a single-line `--- <path> | lines <start>-<end> | summary <line> | body <line> ---` header followed by optional hit context. This header contains the directly readable real file path and 1-based physical line range for targeted reads. Workspace files use workspace-relative paths; registered sources outside the workspace use absolute physical paths. Frontmatter lines are part of the physical line coordinate system. Result titles are omitted because each title is identical to its file name; ranking metadata is also omitted. Use `read` with the returned path, offset, and limit.

lexicalQuery.description: Optional lexical query for exact terms, titles, paths, identifiers, or short keyword combinations.

semanticQuery.description: Optional semantic query for intent- or meaning-based retrieval using natural language.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 5, max: 20).

pathPrefix.description: Optional type-prefixed directory path prefix. Valid roots: `design/`, `memory/`, `skill/`, and `reference/`. Use `skill/` for workflows, SOPs, slash-command skills, tool/package instructions, and reusable execution procedures. Examples: `skill/`, `skill/unity/`, `memory/`, `design/`, `reference/unity/`. Directory prefixes do not end with `.md`.

includeSummary.description: Whether to return each document on one line in `<path> :: <summary>` format. Summary whitespace is collapsed so every document occupies exactly one line. Hit context, line positions, and ranking metadata are omitted. When false, each result uses a single-line document header followed by optional hit context for targeted reads.

includeHitContext.description: Whether to return source text nearest to each hit so its meaning can be checked directly. Used only when `includeSummary` is false. Frontmatter matches return only the decoded `summary` or `maintenanceRules` value; internal metadata is omitted. Context is split on punctuation and line boundaries and capped by `hitContextMaxChars`.

hitContextMaxChars.description: Maximum characters of hit context to return per result (default: 220, min: 80, max: 1000). Used only when `includeSummary` is false and `includeHitContext` is true.
